cs.t: I switched from a typical keyboard to a 75% Keychron K2 HE ( https://www.keychron.com/products/keychron-k2-he-wireless-ma... ) and I like it a lot. I wasn't using the side keys enough for the desk real estate required so this is more efficient. However as a result it's hard to go smaller; I like the function keys! There's also a few notes on how reducing the actuation distance using the magnetic switches is a decent productitiy/RSI-reducer but that's a subject for another thread.
